Allahabad High Court Criticizes UP's Use of Gangsters Act

The Allahabad High Court has criticized the Uttar Pradesh government for its continued use of the Gangsters Act, despite the Supreme Court having previously declared the law "stillborn." The court's remarks were made in relation to the state's application of the act.
